description: Yachts for sale on YATCO (about 6,000 active listings), optionally by builder (e.g. sunseeker, benetti): name, builder, model, year, length, asking price with currency (or price on application), category, staterooms, location, days on market and listing URL, 12 per page, from the public JSON route behind yatco.com search. Values are as the brokers entered them. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

builder.description: Builder name, e.g. sunseeker, azimut, benetti (default: all builders)

page.description: Result page, 1 to 500 (12 yachts per page, default 1)

name: travel_yatco
title: Travel Yatco
